paragraph: ODC1 was 3.3-fold higher in the MYCN-high group than in the rest (p < 0.001). NM23A was robustly up-regulated in the MYCN-high group. NTRK1 did not differ between the MYCN-high group and the rest. BIRC5 was 11-fold higher in the MYCN-high group than in the rest. Expression was normalised to GAPDH. All assays had efficiencies of 90–110 %.
